remote_runtime_shared_sources: Canonical source snapshot once under remote_runtime/shared_legacy; no git history or installed libraries
restore: ZIP entries use repo-relative paths; extract into an empty review checkout/directory. remote_complete retains full remote confirmation outputs without overwriting compact Git selections. Source roots in indices record actual provenance.
overlap_policy: Do not alter already accepted logical wrappers. Count each shared scientific source/path once; preserve transport copies as byte-equal aliases, not new scientific execution.
documentation_precedence: Latest Git scientific documents/figures/code take precedence over historical documentation snapshots inside raw evidence ZIPs
